v4.9.070 - a sync stops moving the furniture

#337 The story flow travels as one thing: the frame order and its breaks
     together, later wins whole, exactly as a shooting order already does. They
     were two separate items merged separately. Old projects still read.
#338 Deleting or inserting a frame above a break moves the break with it, in
     the story flow as well as in a shooting order, so it stays where it was put.
#340 Fixes my own #323. It put back any settings item this device had "not
     sent" - but merely OPENING a project marks everything as unsent, so a
     device that had done nothing put its own copy back over work that had just
     arrived from the other one. A break added on the iPad reached the desk and
     vanished a second later. Mine now only wins if mine is genuinely later.
#341 A sync no longer changes which version each card is showing. The pull
     rebuilt that from nothing, so every card snapped back to its first tab -
     which is why a photo taken in 3x2 flicked back to the main frame the moment
     it synced. The photo was never in danger; the view was being reset.
     Which version you are looking at belongs to the screen, not to the project.

Thirteen tests.
